sources.title: HABS FL-179: Tift-Hemingway House
sources.inspection: Read nine-page architectural/historical record and individually inspected drawings 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Measured overall width around 52 ft 7 in, main facade 36 ft 4 in; flat roof and rear ell; curved corrugated iron gallery canopy; small roof stair housing and brick two-flue chimney. Fine dimensions interpreted at medium-fi scale, not a surveyed reconstruction.

sources.title: HABS FL-179 architectural description
sources.inspection: Read complete description. Gallery ironwork, scored stucco, arched shuttered openings, built-up main roof, raised cistern roof, northwest timber stair and former detached studio connection distinguished.

scope: Main house and attached galleries/ell only. Detached studio, former catwalk, pool and garden structures excluded. Photographs are references only; no image pixels embedded.
